text: On April 17 and 18, 2024 City Council considered and accepted a settlement offer from the owner of 1196 to 1204 Yonge Street, 1206 to 210 Yonge Street and 2 to 8 Birch Avenue. The Ontario Land Tribunal issued a decision on October 10, 2024, approving the proposed development as set out in the settlement offer. The applicant has requested that the Ontario Land Tribunal review its decision. The City Solicitor requires instructions in response to this review request.

City Council on November 12 and 13, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2025) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2025) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2025) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
